tests.title: Existing product detail opens without an error message
tests.goal: Opening a product in the CRM shows no error and add-on templates load.
data: Any existing active product, picked from the list at runtime

steps.text: Open Products and click an existing product
Wait 2 seconds on the Product Details tab
Open Add-On Products > Import From Template

expected.text: No error toast appears (e.g. "undefined: Unexpected Error")
The template picker lists templates or says none exist, with no "Cannot Fetch Templates" error

notes: Retest 2026-10-30 after BUG-005 was set to verified: toast 'undefined: Unexpected Error' still shows on product detail (3 of 3: ids 3187, 3198, 3148); GET cmsapiv2.stagingl10.storeberry.xyz/cmsapi/addon-products/templates/product/3187 -> 500.
